note: The fees include CHF 5 of registered postage per document. Read from the passport office of Basel-Landschaft and Basel-Stadt (its flyer of September 2025); the federal ordinance that sets them (VAwG, SR 143.11, art. 46 and annex 2) wasn't reached: Fedlex's address tried returns its 404 page, and the Federal Department of Foreign Affairs' fee pages answer 403. Abroad, Swiss representations charge other fees. A passport with an identity card together (CHF 158, or 78 under 18) isn't modelled.
